subject: Pilot acceptance orbit: checkpoints & owner commitments
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novaforge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot acceptance orbit: checkpoints & owner commitments

Hi Elena — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum on the Novaforge pilot. I tried to capture the items we agreed on and where we need confirmation from your side.

Summary of goals (what success looks like)
- Validate 95th-percentile generation latency < 450ms for the 3 primary prompt templates (search-assist, summarization, product-similarity) under your sample traffic.
- Achieve embedding similarity parity within 3% of your current vendor on the seed dataset (50k rows).
- No PII leakage in logs; end-to-end audit log for sampled requests.

Proposed pilot structure (the "orbit")
1) Kickoff & infra prep (week 0) — credentials, dataset handoff, brief network test (owner: Novaforge infra / Karthik)
2) Integration sprint (week 1) — embed endpoint + sample inference flows (owner: Novaforge eng / Jonas)
3) Load validation & latency tuning (week 2) — 2 staged runs, perf knobs + batching suggestions (owner: Redwood infra / Karthik)
4) Acceptance window & readout (week 3) — final metrics, quality readout, handoff to product ops (owner: Marissa)

Milestones and tentative dates (UTC converted to your calendar)
- Kickoff call: Mon 2027-08-02 09:00 PT
- Integration sprint complete: Fri 2027-08-06
- Load validation runs: Tue 2027-08-10 and Thu 2027-08-12
- Final readout + acceptance: Wed 2027-08-18 (30–45m)

Immediate asks from Novaforge
- Deliver sample dataset (CSV, 50k rows) and a short doc describing scoring/labels by 2027-08-01 (owner: Elena / Adam)
- Add our service account to the VPC test subnet (instructions in shared Drive)

Attachments: pilot plan v1 + acceptance checklist (attached). I've also put a live checklist in the Drive link above.

If these dates look tight on your side, tell me which weekend we should avoid and we'll shift the load validation. Goal is a 3-week fast loop with clear go/no-go at the readout.

Next step: confirm dataset handoff owner and signoff on the kickoff time.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Adam and I reviewed with our infra/product leads. A couple quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) Dataset: we can deliver a 50k export but two columns are sensitive (user_notes, customer_messages). Can you confirm you only need hashed IDs for those fields for the run?
2) VPC access: our security team needs the SPN and an architectural diagram. Can you share a minimal network diagram and the service account IAM roles?
3) Load windows: Thu 2027-08-12 conflicts with our release to staging; can we move that run to Fri 2027-08-13?

Assuming the above are ok, we can do the kickoff on Mon 2027-08-02 at 09:00 PT.

Elena

Head of Platform, Novaforge
elena@novaforge.com | +1 202-555-0199

Thanks Elena — answers inline and updated asks below. Good catch on the staging conflict; we can shift the second load run to Fri 2027-08-13.

1) Dataset: yes — we only need hashed IDs for user_notes/customer_messages. If you can provide hashing instructions (salt) that would be great; otherwise we can accept one-way hashed columns on your side. (owner: Novaforge / Jonas to validate)
2) VPC: attaching a compact network diagram and the minimal IAM role list. Karthik will run the initial connectivity test during kickoff so security can validate. (attachment: network-diagram.pdf)
3) Load window change: updated schedule below.

Updated milestone dates (UTC):
- Kickoff call: Mon 2027-08-02 09:00 PT
- Integration sprint complete: Fri 2027-08-06
- Load validation runs: Tue 2027-08-10 and Fri 2027-08-13
- Final readout + acceptance: Wed 2027-08-18 10:00 PT

Roles & points of contact

- Redwood integration lead: Jonas Weber
- Redwood infra & perf lead: Karthik Iyer
- Customer success & acceptance: Marissa Cole

Action items (owner, due)
- Novaforge: provide hashed dataset + salt or confirmation of one-way hashes (Elena/Adam, due 2027-08-01)
- Novaforge security: review service account + network diagram and confirm by kickoff (Elena, due 2027-08-02)
- Redwood: prepare acceptance checklist and perf scripts (Karthik, due 2027-08-01)

If you confirm the dataset approach and the moved load run, I'll send a calendar invite with links and a pre-kickoff checklist for each owner.

Jonas

Quick internal note after Elena's reply — tagging ownership and a short runbook we should follow pre-kickoff: 

Runbook highlights
- Day -2 (2027-07-31): smoke test of connectivity using staging VPC credentials (owner: Karthik)
- Day -1 (2027-08-01 morning): verify dataset integrity and be ready to ingest small sample (owner: Jonas)
- Kickoff day: 15-minute infra warmup, then full kickoff agenda (owner: Marissa to run acceptance checklist)

Perf lever checklist (for load validation)
- Batch size sweep: batch=1/4/8 (measure latency tail)
- KV cache warm/no-warm runs (measure delta)
- If 95th > 450ms, fallback plan: switch to a q4 quantized variant and re-run (owner: Karthik)

I'll prepare the perf scripts and a small Kubernetes job for the pre-run load (ETA: 2027-08-01 end of day). Marissa — can you own the readout slide deck and acceptance sign-off artifact?

Karthik
